body_text: Children are active participants in their own learning.

items.title: Choose
items.text_2: Children have real opportunities to make choices, share ideas and express their feelings.

items.title: Be Heard
items.text_2: Educators listen closely to children’s words, actions, interests and questions to shape learning.

items.title: Express
items.text_2: Thinking comes alive through words, drawings, movement, music, construction and pretend play.
